title: Amazon ASIN Lookup & Buy Box Monitor

asins.title: ASINs
asins.description: Amazon ASINs to look up. Full product URLs are accepted too — the ASIN is extracted from them.

marketplace.title: Marketplace
marketplace.description: Amazon domain to query. Prices are pinned to this marketplace's currency regardless of where the run exits from.

includeVariations.title: Include variation family
includeVariations.description: Capture the parent ASIN, child ASINs and variation dimensions (size, colour, flavour) for each product.

expandVariations.title: Also scrape variation children
expandVariations.description: Fetch each child ASIN as its own row, giving per-variant prices. Costs one extra request per child.

buyBoxRetries.title: Buy Box retries on a fresh proxy IP
buyBoxRetries.description: Amazon withholds the offer block from some exit IPs. When the Buy Box is missing, refetch this many times on a new proxy session. Raises seller coverage substantially; costs extra requests only on the ASINs that need it. Set 0 to disable.

maxVariationsPerAsin.title: Max children per ASIN
maxVariationsPerAsin.description: Cap on child ASINs fetched per product when expanding variations.

trackChanges.title: Track changes between runs
trackChanges.description: Compare against the previous run and label each row NEW / UNCHANGED / PRICE_INCREASED / PRICE_DECREASED / BUYBOX_SELLER_CHANGED / BACK_IN_STOCK / OUT_OF_STOCK.

snapshotName.title: Snapshot store name
snapshotName.description: Named key-value store holding the previous run's state. Use separate names to track separate ASIN portfolios.

delaySeconds.title: Delay between products (seconds)
delaySeconds.description: Pacing between product pages. Amazon blocks fast anonymous crawling of /dp/ quickly.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Residential proxy is strongly recommended — Amazon blocks datacentre IPs on product pages within a few requests.
